form.label: L2T - PE (Portable Executable) Forensics
form.description: Comprehensive analysis of Windows executable files, DLLs, import/export functions, and PE security assessment

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | stats count by pe_type | sort pe_type
index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | search (like(description, "*Executable*") OR like(filename, "*.exe")) | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | search (like(description, "*DLL*") OR like(filename, "*.dll")) | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=description "Import hash:\s*(?<import_hash>[a-fA-F0-9]+)" | where isnotnull(import_hash) | stats dc(import_hash)

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count by pe_type | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | eval file_category=case( like(filename, "*.exe"), "Executables", like(filename, "*.dll"), "DLL Files", like(filename, "*.sys"), "System Files", like(filename, "*.ocx"), "ActiveX Controls", true(), "Other PE Files" ) | timechart span=1d count by file_category

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=description "Export DLL name:\s*(?<export_dll>[^\\s]+)" | where isnotnull(export_dll) | eval dll_category=case( match(export_dll, "(?i)(msvcrt|vcruntime|msvcp)"), "Visual C++ Runtime", match(export_dll, "(?i)(kernel32|ntdll|user32)"), "Windows Core", match(export_dll, "(?i)(ole32|oleaut32|shell32)"), "Windows Shell/OLE", match(export_dll, "(?i)(ws2_32|wininet|urlmon)"), "Network/Internet", match(export_dll, "(?i)(gdi32|opengl32|d3d)"), "Graphics/DirectX", match(export_dll, "(?i)(advapi32|crypt32|secur32)"), "Security/Crypto", true(), "Other/Custom" ) | stats count as usage_count, values(pe_type) as pe_types, values(hostname) as hosts, dc(filename) as unique_files by export_dll, dll_category | sort -usage_count | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=filename "^(?<base_path>[^\\\\]+\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\[^\\\\]+)" | eval directory_category=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\system32"), "System32", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\syswow64"), "SysWOW64", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\winsxs"), "WinSxS", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\program files"), "Program Files", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\programdata"), "ProgramData", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\users\\\\"), "User Directories", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\"), "Temporary", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\"), "Windows Other", true(), "Other Locations" ) | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count by directory_category | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | eval file_type=case( like(filename, "*.exe"), "Executables", like(filename, "*.dll"), "DLL Files", like(filename, "*.sys"), "System Files", true(), "Other" ) | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count by hostname, file_type | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=description "Import hash:\s*(?<import_hash>[a-fA-F0-9]+)" | eval risk_level=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\|\\\\downloads\\\\|\\\\desktop\\\\"), "High", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\users\\\\.*\\\\appdata\\\\"), "Medium", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\programdata\\\\|\\\\public\\\\"), "Medium", like(filename, "*.tmp") OR like(filename, "*.temp"), "Medium", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\windows\\\\system32|\\\\windows\\\\syswow64"), "Low", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\program files"), "Low", true(), "Medium" ) | eval suspicious_indicators=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\"), "Temporary Directory", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\downloads\\\\"), "Downloads Folder", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\desktop\\\\"), "Desktop Location", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\appdata\\\\roaming"), "User Roaming Data", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\programdata\\\\"), "ProgramData Directory", like(filename, "*.tmp"), "Temporary File Extension", true(), "Standard Location" ) | where risk_level!="Low" | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | stats count as file_count, values(pe_type) as pe_types, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by filename, hostname, risk_level, suspicious_indicators, import_hash | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort risk_level | head 20

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=description "Import hash:\s*(?<import_hash>[a-fA-F0-9]+)" | rex field=description "Export DLL name:\s*(?<export_dll>[^\\s]+)" | eval file_extension=case( like(filename, "*.exe"), "EXE", like(filename, "*.dll"), "DLL", like(filename, "*.sys"), "SYS", like(filename, "*.ocx"), "OCX", true(), "Other" ) | eval location_risk=case( match(filename, "(?i)\\\\temp\\\\|\\\\downloads\\\\|\\\\desktop\\\\"), "High", match(filename, "(?i)\\\\users\\\\.*\\\\appdata\\\\|\\\\programdata\\\\"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval short_filename=case( len(filename)>50, "..."+substr(filename, len(filename)-47, 50), true(), filename ) | dedup source_long, extracted_sourcetype | table datetime, hostname, pe_type, file_extension, short_filename, export_dll, import_hash, timestamp_desc, location_risk | sort risk_level

index=host sourcetype="l2t:PE" | search hostname=$hostFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (filename="*$fileSearch$*" OR display_name="*$fileSearch$*") | search (filename="*$pathSearch$*" OR display_name="*$pathSearch$*") | search message="*$hashSearch$*" | rex field=description "PE Type:\s*(?<pe_type>[^\\s]+(?:\\s+[^\\s]+)*?)(?:\\s+Import|$)" | search pe_type=$peTypeFilter$ | rex field=description "Import hash:\s*(?<import_hash>[a-fA-F0-9]+)" | rex field=description "Export DLL name:\s*(?<export_dll>[^\\s]+)" | where isnotnull(import_hash) | stats count as file_count, values(pe_type) as pe_types, values(export_dll) as export_dlls, values(filename) as example_files by import_hash | eval example_files=mvjoin(mvdedup(example_files), ", ") | sort -file_count | head 15
